# `aitbc bridge pending`

List pending bridge transfers, optionally filtered by chain.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc bridge pending [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Filter by chain ID |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202/rpc` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc bridge pending
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc bridge pending --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
